# Design System: DSH Agent Development Environment

## Overview

**Creative North Star: "The Dark Cockpit"**

The ADE is an operations surface: people supervise several agents at once, glance away, and come back to "what
needs me". Like an aircraft cockpit, a healthy system is quiet. Working is colourless, finished is plain, and colour
is spent only where a human must act (Needs you) or recover (Failed). Everything else is ink on warm paper, dense,
legible and calm, so a single indigo diamond or red cross is impossible to miss.

The product is ~80 plugins mounted into one DSH Host. Its look is borrowed from the Host theme (`--dsw-*` tokens,
light and dark) and expressed through one kit, `@dshfiles/plugin-ui` (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4 with the `dshx:`
prefix). Plugins never bring their own chrome, palette or header style; they fill one page template. Density is
"BB density": 13px body text, 28–32px controls, 6px radius; touch devices switch to a comfortable density.

Since the visual refresh (P0) `@dshfiles/ui-styles` retunes the Host theme itself: a generated
block re-tints the Host neutrals to warm stone, pins the Host aliases to one 11-step palette, remaps the Host radii and
sets Geist as the default family, so native core surfaces and plugins draw from the same values. **Light is the default
scheme; dark is equally finished.**

The plan behind this file is [docs/ade-ux/README.md](docs/ade-ux/README.md); its §3 glossary governs copy and
§4.7 the status vocabulary below.

**Key characteristics:**

- One page anatomy for every plugin page; one list row; one empty state; one tab style.
- Colour is a signal, never decoration. Category colour exists only for data (graph lanes, charts, project tones).
- Container-sized, not viewport-sized: every surface works from a 360px phone pane to a wide split.
- Sentence case everywhere; plugin names never appear in labels.

## Colors

The palette is **generated, not hand-picked**: `palette({ hue, chroma, accentHue, contrast, scheme })` in
`plugins/@dshfiles/plugin-ui/src/theme/palette.ts` returns 11 neutral steps in `oklch(L C 65)` (warm stone), an indigo
accent and three status trios. `scripts/emit-theme-css.ts` writes the result to
`plugins/@dshfiles/ui-styles/src/theme.generated.css`; never edit that file or restate its values. Dark chroma is
0.007 on fills and borders and 0.005 on text; light is half as warm. The dark theme is selected by
`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` and every token switches with it.

Users pick a preset in Settings › General › Appearance (Warm stone default, Neutral, High contrast, Slate blue, Moss;
`plugin-ui/src/theme/appearance.ts`), optionally override the grey hue and tint, accent hue and contrast, and choose
Geist or the system font for interface and code. The static block stays the first paint and the whole default theme;
a different choice is the same generator run in the client, injected over it. Write CSS against the tokens and it
follows every preset; never assume warm stone or indigo in a rule. Every preset keeps AA text in both schemes.

Each step has one job. Plugins reach them through the semantic Tailwind tokens; `--dshx-tone-<step>` (and
`--dshx-tone-<name>`) exist for the rare raw CSS rule.

| Step            | Job                                  | Tailwind token               | Host variable                                                  | Light     | Dark      |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------- |
| 0 bg            | page, cards in light                 | `background`, `card` (light) | `--dsw-alias-bg-base`                                          | `#fefcfa` | `#110e0b` |
| 1 panel         | sidebar, code blocks, dark cards     | `card` (dark)                | `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill`, `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1` (dark) | `#f7f5f3` | `#161311` |
| 2 raised        | hover fill, chips, tab track, bubble | `muted`, `secondary`         | `--dsw-alias-bg-module-platform`                               | `#eeecea` | `#1e1b18` |
| 3 selected      | selected row, active nav             | —                            | `--dsw-specific-sidebar-nav-item-active`                       | `#e8e6e4` | `#24211e` |
| 4 line          | hairline border                      | `border`                     | `--dsw-alias-border-l2`                                        | `#e1dfdd` | `#292623` |
| 5 border        | control border                       | `input`                      | `--dsw-alias-border-l3`                                        | `#d6d4d2` | `#33302d` |
| 6 border-strong | hover border, emphasis               | —                            | `--dsw-alias-border-l4`                                        | `#bfbdbb` | `#423f3c` |
| 7 strong        | idle glyphs, scrollbars              | —                            | (ramp)                                                         | `#9f9e9d` | `#575552` |
| 8 faint         | tertiary text, placeholder (≥ 3:1)   | —                            | `--dsw-alias-label-tertiary`                                   | `#81807f` | `#82807d` |
| 9 muted         | secondary text (AA)                  | `muted-foreground`           | `--dsw-alias-label-secondary`                                  | `#646362` | `#a7a4a1` |
| 10 text         | primary text, primary fill (AA)      | `foreground`, `primary`      | `--dsw-alias-label-primary`                                    | `#1b1a19` | `#f3efed` |

| Signal                                             | Tailwind token | Host variable                                            | Light     | Dark      |
| -------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------- |
| Accent indigo (focus, selection, Needs you, links) | `info`, `ring` | `--dsw-alias-state-business-primary`, `--dsw-alias-link` | `#3e5ed8` | `#839ffc` |
| Danger (hue 25)                                    | `destructive`  | `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary`                        | `#a83634` | `#fa8880` |
| Success (hue 150)                                  | `success`      | `--dsw-alias-state-success-primary`                      | `#00792f` | `#65c67d` |
| Warning (hue 80)                                   | `warning`      | `--dsw-alias-state-warn-primary`                         | `#805400` | `#dca331` |

Every status is a **trio**: the colour itself for text and icons, `-bg` (12% alpha) for a tinted fill and `-border`
(30% alpha) for its border (`--dshx-tone-danger-bg`, …); badges, diff lines and error blocks use the trio, never a
solid fill. Text steps, the accent and every status colour hold WCAG AA (4.5:1) on bg, panel and raised in both
schemes; `plugin-ui/tests/palette.test.ts` enforces it. Hover and pressed washes are the ink at 6–14% alpha so they
work on any surface.

Kit-only hues the Host lacks — `teal`, `violet`, `graph-1..6`, project tones — live in
`plugins/@dshfiles/plugin-ui/src/styles.css` with light and dark values. Use them only for categorical data.

**Rules.** Use semantic tokens only (`bg-background`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`, `bg-destructive`…),
never raw hex in plugin code. Indigo is never a button fill and never decoration: it marks focus, selection and Needs
you. Success green is for confirmations and healthy metrics, not for "done" rows (done is muted). Warning amber is for
configuration that blocks a feature (sign-in required), not for status. No pure `#000` anywhere.

A DSH bump that renames a Host variable we override fails `ui-styles/tests/host-variables.test.ts`; fix the name in
`plugin-ui/src/theme/theme-css.ts` and regenerate.

## Typography

One family, **Geist** (variable), for every surface, native and plugin alike; code and identifiers use **Geist Mono**.
Both are vendored in `plugins/@dshfiles/ui-styles/src/fonts` (latin, SIL OFL 1.1) and set through the Host's default
stacks (`--dsh-font-family-text-default`, `--dsh-font-family-code-default`), so a family typed in Settings › Font still
wins and Settings › Font size still scales everything. Read the family through `--dsw-font-family` /
`--ds-font-family-code` (`font-sans`, `font-mono`); never name a font in plugin CSS. Apply `dshx:font-mono!` on
controls because the Host's unlayered form-control rule wins otherwise. The scale is compact and steps by weight more
than size:

| Role          | Size / line                     | Weight       | Use                                             |
| ------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------- |
| Display       | 26/32 (`text-display`)          | 600, -0.02em | Hero headline (new thread)                      |
| Page title    | 20/28 (`text-title`, `text-xl`) | 600, -0.01em | The page `h1`, exactly one per page             |
| Section title | 13px (`text-sm`)                | 600          | `PageSection` `h2`, card titles                 |
| Body / UI     | 13px (`text-sm`) / 1.45         | 400          | Rows, descriptions, forms                       |
| Prose         | 14px (`text-base`)              | 400          | Assistant messages, long descriptions           |
| Label / meta  | 12px (`text-xs`) / 1.35         | 400–500      | Chips, timestamps, helper text, badges          |
| Dense meta    | 11px, 12px phone (`text-2xs`)   | 400–500      | Counters, kbd hints, graph and chart labels     |
| Code          | 12–12.5px mono                  | 400          | Commands, paths, ids that must be read verbatim |

The minimum is 11px; nothing smaller. `text-2xs` is that minimum as a token: it reads `--dshx-density-text-min`, so it
grows to 12px on a phone. Never write `text-[Npx]`; `node --run check:design-tokens` ratchets it. Descriptions cap at 72ch. Labels are sentence case; ALL-CAPS form labels are
retired. Numbers in counters, times, token counts and tables use `tabular-nums`.

### Density

Two densities, switched by pointer and width, never by user agent (`plugin-ui/src/styles.css`):

| Token                               | Compact (desktop) | Comfortable (coarse pointer)                  |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `--dshx-density-text-ui` / `-prose` | 13 / 14px         | 15 / 15px (phone width or `@max-pane-narrow`) |
| `--dshx-density-text-meta` / `-min` | 12 / 11px         | 13 / 12px (phone width or `@max-pane-narrow`) |
| `--dshx-density-text-input`         | 13px              | 16px (every coarse pointer: no Safari zoom)   |
| `--dshx-density-target`             | 28px              | 44px (every coarse pointer)                   |

Safe areas: `--dshx-safe-top|right|bottom|left` (`env(safe-area-inset-*)`) on the phone top bar, tab bar, composer and
sheets. Kit buttons, toggles and menu rows already get 44px hit areas on a coarse pointer.

## Layout

**Page anatomy** (`Page` from `@dshfiles/plugin-ui/components/page`):

```
┌ Page (its own @container; padding 20px, 12px below 28rem) ───────────────────────────┐
│ h1 Heading  12  [meta chip] [meta chip]          [Secondary] [Secondary] [⋯] [Primary] │
│ One-line description, muted, ≤ 72ch                                                    │
│ [ Tab · Tab · Tab ]   ← optional, one segmented style                                  │
│ ─ body: PageSection (h2 · meta · actions) → EntityList / form / table / EmptyState ─   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- At most one primary action. Secondary actions are outline buttons while the page is at least 42rem wide and fold
  into the `⋯` overflow menu below that; the primary never folds.
- Pages fill their pane (no centred max-width column). Body stacks use 12px gaps; sections 16px.
- Size by container, never by viewport: the page root is `@container`; children query `@max-pane-narrow` (< 28rem,
  phones and 360–480px panes) and `@max-pane-compact` (< 42rem, split layouts). Collapse order: labels become icons,
  secondary chips hide or wrap, primary text truncates, and only then does a row wrap.
- No horizontal page overflow at 390px. Filter rows scroll sideways (`overflow-x-auto`) instead of wrapping into a
  column of chips.

## Elevation & Depth

Flat, tonal layering. Surfaces separate by hairline borders (`border-border`) and the panel/raised steps, not by
shadow. Four elevation levels, and only the composer floats at rest:

| Level | Token              | Use                                                |
| ----- | ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| s0    | `shadow-s0` (none) | Everything at rest: pages, cards, rows             |
| s1    | `shadow-s1`        | The composer card, sticky bars (batch actions)     |
| s2    | `shadow-s2`        | Menus, popovers, selects, floating Dockview groups |
| s3    | `shadow-s3`        | Dialogs and phone bottom sheets                    |

Dark adds a 1px inner top highlight (`inset 0 1px 0`) to every level so raised layers read against near-black. Only
s2/s3 may add a backdrop blur. Declare depth once — a bordered card has no shadow. Stacking bands: Host modals 1000,
kit dialogs/sheets 1050, floating layers (select, popover, menu, tooltip) 1100.

## Motion

One enter curve, one exit curve, five durations (`--dshx-duration-*`, `ease-enter`/`ease-exit`):

| Duration | Use             |
| -------- | --------------- |
| 80ms     | hover, press    |
| 120ms    | collapse, fade  |
| 160ms    | menus, popovers |
| 220ms    | panels          |
| 280ms    | phone sheets    |

Enter with `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`; exits take 100ms with `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)`. Working state is a
2.2s shimmer, not a spinner, and it pauses off-screen. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` animate opacity only. The
Motion presets in `@dshfiles/plugin-ui/motion` are the code path for anything beyond a CSS transition.

## Shapes

One radius scale for kit and native: **4 chips · 6 controls and rows · 8 cards and code · 12 composer, menus and
dialogs · 16 phone sheets** (`rounded-sm|md|lg|xl|2xl`). The Host's `--dsw-radius-xs..panel` are remapped onto it
(4/6/8/12/12/16), so native bubbles, composer and panels follow. Badges and chips are full pills. Borders are 1px
hairlines; no coloured side borders.

Heights: 24 compact · 28 default control · 32 list row · 36 composer bar · 44 touch (`h-control-compact`,
`h-control`, `h-row`, `h-bar`, `h-touch`).

## Components

**Primary button — black.** `Button` `variant="default"` is the Host brand fill (`#0f1115` light, `#f9fafb` dark),
which most pages already used (MCP Add server, Memory, Backlog New, Hosts). One per page. Header secondary actions are
`outline` `sm`; row verbs are `outline` or `ghost` `sm`; destructive verbs `destructive` and always behind a
confirmation when they lose work.

**Tabs — one style.** The segmented `TabsList` (muted track, paper active pill) for page views, rendered by `Page`
`tabs`. A filter over one list (Running / Finished / All) is a `ToggleGroup`, which looks the same. No underline tabs
on pages.

**EmptyState.** One sentence, centred, muted, at most one outline action. It never draws its own frame; the list or
card it sits in does. Loading is a `Spinner`, not an empty state.

**Status vocabulary** (`WorkStatus`, `StatusGlyph` from `components/work-status`). Exactly six states for every work
item — thread, subagent, job, check, workspace, host. Plugins map onto them and add detail text, never colours.

| State     | Meaning                              | Glyph                 | Row title |
| --------- | ------------------------------------ | --------------------- | --------- |
| Working   | progressing without you              | ring spinner, no colour, phase-synced, paused off screen | normal |
| Needs you | cannot continue without you          | indigo filled diamond | normal    |
| Failed    | broke, with a recovery verb          | red cross             | normal    |
| Ready     | finished, not yet seen or landed     | solid ink dot         | **bold**  |
| Idle      | seen, nothing pending                | faint ring            | normal    |
| Done      | landed or closed; workspace released | muted check           | muted     |

Two glyph-only states draw but never group or sort: **stale** (dashed faint ring: a reading or workspace that may be
out of date) and **stopped** (muted square: cancelled or parked by the user).

**EntityRow / EntityList** (`components/entity-row`). One row shape: `leading control · status glyph · title · muted
meta chips · trailing inline verb`, with an optional muted description line and full-width children (an output pane).
The middle is one button when the row selects; leading and trailing stay separate controls. Lists are one bordered
card with hairline dividers. In narrow panes meta wraps under the title and trailing verbs drop to their own line.

**PageSection.** `h2` (section title) that names its `section` region, optional muted meta ("3 enabled") and actions.

## Do's and Don'ts

- **Do** build every page from `Page` → `PageSection` → `EntityList`/form/table → `EmptyState`.
- **Do** map plugin states onto the six `WorkStatus` values; put nuance in the detail text.
- **Do** use the glossary: thread, project, workspace, host, land, done, agent, Needs you, usage, memory
  ([plan §3](docs/ade-ux/README.md#glossary-enforced-in-copy)). `node --run check:copy` ratchets banned terms.
- **Don't** colour working or healthy states; don't add a second attention colour.
- **Don't** put plugin names in labels ("pulls.review: Reviews", "Thread Sidebar: Navigation").
- **Don't** use an indigo or blue primary button, an icon-tile header, underline page tabs or ALL-CAPS labels.
- **Don't** centre a page in a max-width column or size a pane with viewport breakpoints (`sm:`/`md:`).
- **Don't** leak raw ids or absolute paths into labels; show the entity's name and keep the id in a tooltip.
- **Don't** add a control to a fixed surface. The composer bar is `+ · mode · ⋯ · model · send` with one meta line,
  the thread header is one row with one `⋯`, a reply row is copy + `⋯`. A new verb goes into the matching `⋯` menu
  or registry (composer More items, thread menu sections, reply actions), or shows only while it carries live state
  (a pending count). Every upstream batch merged on 2026-11-11 broke this rule at least once.
- **Don't** draw a second control for something that already has one (restart, find, Since you left, notifications):
  feed the existing control instead.
